claim_rules.4x_faster: baseline median elapsed / challenger median elapsed >= 4 and challenger quality is not lower
claim_rules.4x_time_efficient: challenger quality per minute / baseline quality per minute >= 4 and challenger quality is not lower
claim_rules.4x_token_efficient: challenger quality per 1000 tokens / baseline >= 4 and challenger quality is not lower
claim_rules.higher_quality: report the point delta on a predeclared rubric
claim_rules.safety_failure: disqualifies the attempt regardless of aggregate score
